vibe: Professional Medical, Trustworthy, Modern, Clean, Authoritative

navbar.links: font-semibold text-sm tracking-wide text-[#0A1F0A] hover:text-[#246B24] transition-colors

hero_carousel.content_padding: p-12 md:p-24 flex flex-col justify-center h-full

stats_section.style: Grid layout grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-8 bg-[#246B24] text-white py-16

services_grid.style: Bento grid (Tetris mode) grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6
services_grid.card_style: bg-white p-8 rounded-2xl border border-border/50 hover:border-[#246B24]/30 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300

testimonials.card_style: bg-[#F8FAF8] p-8 rounded-2xl min-w-[300px] border border-[#246B24]/10

appointment_form.style: Two-column layout. Left side text/imagery, right side form.
appointment_form.inputs: Shadcn inputs customized with h-12 rounded-lg bg-[#F8FAF8] border-none focus-visible:ring-[#246B24]
appointment_form.submit_button: w-full h-14 rounded-full bg-[#246B24] hover:bg-[#1B4D1B] text-white font-bold text-lg

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'framer-motion' for reveal animations and the animated stats counters.
Install '@fontsource/cabinet-grotesk' and '@fontsource/manrope' or add to index.css.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the bento grids, do not rely on Shadcn Card if it restricts layout.
Use Shadcn UI for the Appointment Booking Form (Input, Select, Button) but remove the vercel default look and make it match the design system.
Ensure 'data-testid' is added to all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs).
Hero carousel MUST use Shadcn Carousel, filled 100% width and height. Images MUST have a bg-black/40 overlay to ensure white text is readable.
Use the exact media URLs provided in this JSON. Do not use placeholders.
Follow the generous spacing logic: use py-24 or py-32 between major sections.
Use the Primary Color (#246B24) strictly for CTA buttons and key accent icons. Do not overuse it.
